title: Weekend service handback — quick announce draft (Meera)
content:
Purpose:
Short internal announcement for SRE/infra + product liaisons about the upcoming weekend handback window and expectations. Draft is a lean note for distribution to the oncall rota and for the morning sync.

Audience: eng-sre oncall, infra rotation, product oncall liaisons, duty managers. Not for external customers.

High level message (one sentence):
Weekend oncall handback will occur at 09:00 PT Monday; please confirm ownership, escalate paths, and prefix any shift notes with 'WEEKEND-HANDBACK' in the rota doc and Slack thread.

Quick talking points (for the oncall to copy into Slack):
- Handback window: 09:00–09:30 PT Monday.
- Who to ping: primary oncall (channel + pager), secondary, duty manager (listed below).
- Known issues: token-billing spike on Sat 21:00 PT (mitigated), embeddings cache warmup slower for longer sequences — watch /dash/embeddings latency chart.
- Fallbacks: routing -> prefer 'redwood-small' variant if dedicated capacity is constrained; runbook OPS-4821 for automated fallback reset.
- If outage persists >15 min escalate to Duty Manager and create OPS incident ticket.

Handback checklist (copy into handoff message):
- [ ] Confirm primary owner for next business day (add name in rota).
- [ ] Post shift notes in #ops-weekend-handback thread (short bullets).
- [ ] Attach any relevant alerts (pagerduty IDs) and span-of-impact (models, regions).
- [ ] Mark any ongoing mitigations as "active" in the runbook and link PRs.
- [ ] Leave suggested follow-ups for product or infra owners (who should own work after escalation window).

Suggested Slack blurb (short):
"Planned weekend handback Monday 09:00 PT — primary: @NAME, secondary: @NAME. Active items: billing spike (mitigated), embeddings cache warmup (monitor). Please add your shift notes in #ops-weekend-handback and escalate per OPS-4821 if issues persist >15m."

Q&A (anticipate these questions and short answers):
Q: What if the handback time needs to move?
A: Notify @duty-manager and post to #ops-weekend-handback; we will extend the window in 30m increments.

Q: Who is responsible for customer-facing comms?
A: CS will draft an advisory if user-visible latency or failures occur; SRE must confirm scope and severity first.

Q: Do we switch routing to hosted variants automatically?
A: No. Fallbacks are automated only for critical capacity tiers (see runbook). Manual routing changes require approval from infra lead or duty manager.

Notes to self / todo before publish:
- Confirm duty manager names for this weekend (Liam/Rowan?) — ACTION: ping Liam.
- Verify embeddings latency chart link (replace /dash placeholder with real url).
- Shorten Slack blurb to fit pin length.
- Run this by Priya for tone + risk wording.

Open items / questions I want to resolve during review:
- Decide whether to call out specific model variants in the public blurb (risk: confuses non-eng recipients).
- Should we include a short "what we fixed" line for the billing spike or leave it internal?
- Do we want to offer office hours post-handoff (15–30m) for quick Q&A?

People and contact info (for handback message / quick paste):
- Primary oncall template: @<primary-oncall> (pagerduty ID: PD-XXXX)
- Secondary: @<secondary>
- Duty manager oncall: Liam O'Connor (@liam)
- CS escalation: Priya Patel (@priya)

References / runbooks to link in final message:
- OPS-4821 (Weekend handback runbook)
- Incident runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Incident+Response

Action items before sending:
- [ ] Update rota with final names (me)
- [ ] Replace placeholders with actual pagerduty IDs and dashboard links (Priya to confirm)
- [ ] Quick review with Rowan for wording and scope
- [ ] Post announcement to #ops-weekend-handback and pin it

Tone notes: keep short, operational, and reassuring. Avoid customer language; keep product mentions high level.

Draft history: created as personal scratchpad for quick handoff comms. Meera 2026-03-01 initial; edits 2026-03-10 after convo with Priya.

Send plan: after final review, post Monday 08:30 PT as a reminder and again 08:55 PT as pre-handover ping.

END OF DRAFT
